correctStatement: In NIST reference19016, the molecular ion64 is the base peak;49 is a fragment at26.62% of it.

oldText: The base peak (100% abundance) is the most stable, most abundant fragment cation, often not the molecular ion.
correctStatement: The base peak is the most abundant detected ion, set to100%; it may be a molecular ion or a fragment. Its intensity also depends on formation and detection, not simply thermodynamic stability.

correctStatement: The study screened1,281 genes. Separate it from the Medicare three-condition panel introduced inNovember2023.

correctStatement: Early-embryo edits can be mosaic. A germline edit may be inherited; uniform editing and transmission are not guaranteed.

oldText: for every multifactorial condition with a genetic contribution, no prevention exists and management remains the only option.
correctStatement: Risk of multifactorial diseases can be reduced by changing exposures, for example lifestyle intervention reduces type2 diabetes incidence in people at high risk.

correctStatement: Bone-conduction systems can assist selected mixed hearing loss and single-sided sensorineural deafness by routing sound to a functioning cochlea.

oldText: destroys any residual natural hearing in that ear
correctStatement: Cochlear implantation can damage residual hearing, but it can sometimes be preserved. Do not claim universal destruction.

oldText: In 1978 Graeme Clark, at the University of Melbourne, switched on the first multi-channel cochlear implant in Rod Saunders.
correctStatement: Clark implanted the Melbourne multichannel prototype in 1978. An earlier Vienna multichannel implantation occurred in December 1977. Remove the unqualified first claim.
